notes.title: Content update #1: Mekanika now released!
notes.content:
Ready to roll again?
The world of Spin & Roll gets turned on its head as the world of machines and mechanization come head to head in 15 brand new stages loaded full of new hazards, tricky traps and even more deadly foes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39540834/f21f07d703ca10992f7c20be2d0a7cbef271ba6f.png

Weave your way around electrical conduits, avoid spikey new hazards, dodge whirling Mekopters and try not to fall prey to the hovering Bombits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39540834/08075c607e8aa65e7a6827378f6dd452e3426974.png

Each new stage has been carefully crafted to pack the game with a fresh new look and feel whilst still giving you a familiar sense of challenge and fun. And with even bigger levels than ever before, there's much, much more to see and do in this jam-packed content update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39540834/aa30244b7d467b8897a4b6ca50c7a5b413c26696.png

We hope you enjoy this new pack as much as we had creating it!
- Savania Games

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 released
notes.content:
We recently updated Spin & Roll with a new patch. Please find the latest patch details below.

Patch 1.2.0

• Fixed an issue where fountain sound effect wasn't set to the current SFX volume level.

• Resolved a problem where bombs weren't stopping whilst the game was paused.

• Reduced ambient sound of some looping objects.

• Fixed an issue where you could fall into a hole in the level 'Duck and cover' but could not escape it (you will now correctly lose a ball for doing so!).

• When using the keyboard, pressing ESC now pauses the game.
